caption:
Every running day starts with the same plate before the sun is up.

Every breakfast is included across the 9 days, whether you wake in the cloud forest at Lauráceas or on the Pacific coast at Parador. When the route drops 2,350 metres down the Savegre on the Queen Stage, mountain families open their kitchen doors to runners with fruit, empanadas, and hot agua dulce.

You eat what the valley grows, because 93 kilometres across this country demand real food from people who know how to cook it.

The Trail Running Expedition · 5 – 13 December 2026, 20 – 28 February 2027, 7 – 15 August 2027 · Details in the bio.
